name: What is the typical process for designing and building a custom hardscaping project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and building a custom hardscaping project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and functional needs for your outdoor space. Following this, our design-build team develops CAD-supported layouts and material selections, ensuring the plan aligns with your home's aesthetic and budget. Once the design is finalized and approved, we handle all necessary permit coordination and construction, providing a managed process from concept to completion. This integrated approach ensures consistent quality and clear communication throughout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, CAD-supported design, material selection, permit coordination, and construction, all managed by our integrated design-build team for a seamless experience.
